verdict.rationale: Convex documents first-party building blocks for app development. These include integrations with React, Next.js, Remix, TanStack Start, React Native, Vue, Nuxt and Svelte, plus the official Convex Auth library. The CLI generates types in convex/_generated for end-to-end type safety, and `npm create convex@latest` scaffolds new projects. missing for 10: explicit SDK/client-library reference docs naming the packages and their APIs, evidence of SDKs beyond the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
